label: PF Backlog 88
title: Cleanup: rerunning a stage must not leave stale prior-stage artifacts (e.g. design-output/design.md from an old run)
body: Observed: products/ProductForge-Dashboard/{artifacts/1/design-output.md, docs/design.md, docs/requirements.md} are leftovers from an old stage-1 run and appear 'under' ideation confusingly. Fix: when a stage is invalidated/rerun, purge its own stale artifacts (artifact_store) and any derived docs it produced, so only current-run outputs are present. Guarded to the project's own artifact/doc paths.
